'''Ryan Hase EBO Muscle''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Ryan Hase]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls122.htm EBO Muscle], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]).
